2.w: “Even today my complaint is still bitter; his hand is heavy despite my groaning.

3.w: O that I knew where I might find him, that I could come to his place of residence!

4.w: I would lay out my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.

5.w: I would know with what words he would answer me and understand what he would say to me.

6.w: Would he contend with me with great power? No, he would only pay attention to me.

7.w: There an upright person could present his case before him, and I would be delivered forever from my judge.

8.w: “If I go to the east, he is not there, and to the west, yet I do not perceive him.

9.w: In the north when he is at work, I do not see him; when he turns to the south, I see no trace of him.

10.w: But he knows the pathway that I take; if he tested me, I would come forth like gold.

11.w: My feet have followed his steps closely; I have kept to his way and have not turned aside.

12.w: I have not departed from the commands of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my allotted portion.

13.w: But he is unchangeable, and who can change him? Whatever he has desired, he does.

14.w: For he fulfills his decree against me, and many such things are his plans.

15.w: That is why I am terrified in his presence; when I consider, I am afraid because of him.

16.w: Indeed, God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.

17.w: Yet I have not been silent because of the darkness, because of the thick darkness that covered my face.
